import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
event = payload.get('hook_event_name')
record = {'event': event, 'time_ns': time.monotonic_ns(),
          'active': payload.get('stop_hook_active'),
          'last': payload.get('last_assistant_message'),
          'delta': payload.get('delta'), 'index': payload.get('index'),
          'final': payload.get('final')}
with (root / 'hook-events.jsonl').open('a') as out:
    out.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
if event == 'Stop' and not payload.get('stop_hook_active'):
    print(json.dumps({'decision': 'block', 'reason': 'This is an isolated hook test. Now reply only: REVISED_MARKER'}))
else:
    print('{}')

import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
model = 'claude-sonnet-5-5'
routes = ('ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL', 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL',
          'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK', 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX', 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY')
assert not any(os.environ.get(key) for key in routes), 'Routing override present'
assert not (root / 'events.jsonl').exists(), 'No overwriting an earlier run'
settings = {'autoMemoryEnabled': False, 'claudeMdExcludes': ['/Users/kouko/**'],
            'hooks': {'Stop': [{'hooks': [{'type': 'command',
                 'command': '/usr/bin/sandbox-exec -f ' + str(root / 'hooks.sb') + ' /usr/bin/python3 ' + str(root / 'hook.py')}]}]},
            'sandbox': {'enabled': True, 'autoAllowBashIfSandboxed': True,
                        'allowUnsandboxedCommands': False, 'failIfUnavailable': True,
                        'filesystem': {'denyRead': ['/Users/kouko/'], 'denyWrite': ['/Users/kouko/']},
                        'network': {'allowedDomains': [], 'strictAllowlist': True}}}
(root / 'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps(settings, indent=2))
args = ['/Users/kouko/.local/bin/claude', '-p', '--model', model, '--effort', 'medium',
        '--restricted', '--strict-mcp-config', '--setting-sources', '', '--settings', str(root / 'settings.json'),
        '--tools', '', '--output-format', 'stream-json', '--verbose', '--include-partial-messages',
        '--include-hook-events', '--no-session-persistence', '--max-budget-usd', '0.20']
prompt = 'This is a harmless synthetic streaming test. Reply with exactly ORIGINAL_MARKER and nothing else.'
(root / 'invocation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'argv': args, 'prompt': prompt}, indent=2))
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM='/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1', TMPDIR=str(root))
with (root / 'stderr.txt').open('x') as err, (root / 'events.jsonl').open('x') as out:
    p = subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                         stderr=err, text=True, bufsize=1)
    p.stdin.write(prompt)
    p.stdin.close()
    for line in p.stdout:
        item = {'time_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), 'event': json.loads(line)}
        out.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
        out.flush()
    code = p.wait(timeout=180)
assert code == 0, 'CLI did not complete'
events = [json.loads(line)['event'] for line in (root / 'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
final = next(x for x in reversed(events) if x.get('type') == 'result')
assert not final.get('is_error') and list(final.get('modelUsage', {})) == [model]
print(json.dumps({'result': final.get('result'), 'modelUsage': list(final['modelUsage']),
                  'cost_usd': final.get('total_cost_usd')}, ensure_ascii=False))

          'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK', 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX', 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY')
assert not any(os.environ.get(key) for key in routes)
settings = json.loads((root / 'settings.json').read_text())
settings['hooks'] = {'MessageDisplay': [{'hooks': [{'type': 'command',
    'command': '/usr/bin/sandbox-exec -f ' + str(root / 'hooks.sb') + ' /usr/bin/python3 ' + str(root / 'display_hook.py')}]}]}
(root / 'settings-display.json').write_text(json.dumps(settings, indent=2))
args = ['/Users/kouko/.local/bin/claude', '-p', '--model', 'claude-sonnet-5-5', '--effort', 'medium',
        '--restricted', '--strict-mcp-config', '--setting-sources', '', '--settings', str(root / 'settings-display.json'),
        '--tools', '', '--output-format', 'stream-json', '--verbose', '--include-partial-messages',
        '--include-hook-events', '--no-session-persistence', '--max-budget-usd', '0.20']
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM='/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1', TMPDIR=str(root))

assert not outpath.exists()
with outpath.open('x') as out, (root / 'display-stderr.txt').open('x') as err:
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, env=env, input='Reply with exactly ORIGINAL_DISPLAY_MARKER.',
                       stdout=out, stderr=err, text=True, timeout=180)

print(json.dumps({'result': final.get('result'), 'modelUsage': list(final['modelUsage']),
                  'cost_usd': final.get('total_cost_usd'),
